summary.en: Intas and its Accord businesses emphasize generics and biosimilars, combining internal capabilities with external partnerships. Xdivane is a verified investigational oncology biosimilar, while several other prominent Accord biosimilars are already approved.
summary.zh: Intas及其Accord业务以仿制药和生物类似药为重点,结合内部能力与外部合作。Xdivane是经核实的在研肿瘤生物类似药,而Accord的其他多个知名生物类似药已获批。

ind.zh: 关键性对照研究中的黑色素瘤

next.en: Planned interim analysis in Q2 2027; FDA BLA submission targeted for mid-2027
next.zh: 计划2027年第二季度进行中期分析;FDA BLA提交目标为2027年中

watch.en: Xbrane’s Q3 report targets Xdivane interim analysis in Q2 2027 and a US BLA in mid-2027.
watch.zh: Xbrane第三季度报告的目标是2027年第二季度完成Xdivane中期分析,2027年中提交美国BLA。

watch.en: Intas conducts clinical development and Accord handles global commercialization of Xdivane.
watch.zh: Intas负责Xdivane的临床开发,Accord负责其全球商业化。

watch.en: Intas assumed financing for certain Xdivane CMC development costs, offset against future profit sharing with an 18% mark-up.
watch.zh: Intas承担了Xdivane部分CMC开发成本的融资,以18%加成与未来利润分成抵销。

watch.en: Accord’s 2026 news records approvals or launches for filgrastim, pegfilgrastim, golimumab and denosumab biosimilars.
watch.zh: Accord 2026年的新闻记录了filgrastim、pegfilgrastim、golimumab和denosumab生物类似药的获批或上市。

gaps: No public complete named group pipeline, quarterly financial report or company-wide numerical phase totals were verified.
Xdivane is described as pivotal and registration-enabling, without an explicit numerical phase in the reviewed partner reports; phase remains null.
Only one eligible investigational asset was verified. The current Indian filing or clinical stage for BAT2506 was not established.
Accord’s pipeline-growth graphics date from January 2024, before June 2026, and do not identify current named candidates. Xdivane timing comes from the Q3 2026 partner report.
No additional development code was verified for Xdivane.
